user.title: Garden Irrigation — global settings
user.description: Set up your pump, backwash valve, and timing defaults. Both switches are optional — leave empty if you don't have that hardware.

data.backwash_interval: Automatic backwash interval — seconds of cumulative watering between automatic backwashes (0 = off)
data.backwash_threshold: End-of-queue backwash threshold — minimum seconds of total watering before an end-of-queue backwash runs

data_description.pump_switch: The Home Assistant switch entity that controls your well pump. Will be turned on before any valve opens.
data_description.backwash_switch: The Home Assistant switch entity for the backwash valve. If empty, all backwash behavior is disabled.
data_description.multiplier: Multiplies every zone's default duration (e.g. 2.5 = 2.5× longer).
data_description.pump_pressure_delay: Time to wait after turning on the pump and before opening a valve. Runs once at the start of a queue.
data_description.backwash_pressure_delay: Time to wait after turning on the pump (or keeping it on) and before opening the backwash valve.
data_description.backwash_runtime: How long the backwash valve stays open.
data_description.backwash_interval: After this many seconds of cumulative watering, the controller pauses watering and runs a backwash, then resumes.
data_description.backwash_threshold: When a queue finishes, run a final backwash if at least this much watering happened (or if the queue was started by the timer).
data_description.daily_start: Time of day to automatically start 'Water all'.
data_description.daily_timer_enabled: If on, the daily timer fires; if off, the timer does nothing.

zone.title: Add an irrigation zone
zone.description: Add one zone. After saving, you can add more.

data.name: Display name
data.order: Run order for 'Water all' (lower runs first)

data_description.name: Friendly name shown in the dashboard.
data_description.entity_id: The Home Assistant switch entity that opens this zone's valve.
data_description.duration: Default time this zone runs. Effective time = duration × global multiplier.
data_description.order: Smaller numbers run earlier. Use gaps (10, 20, 30…) to make later reordering easier.

abort.already_configured: Garden Irrigation is already configured. Use 'Configure' on the existing entry to change settings.
